# Synthetic demonstration dataset

**SYNTHETIC — NOT VALID FOR PROCUREMENT.** Generated by `python scripts/generate_synthetic_data.py` (deterministic). All
companies, the registrar and certificate numbers are fictional; nothing imitates a real HAL-issued, government or accredited
document. Use only in the demonstration/test environment, never in a real evaluation.

| Vendor | Submission | Certification | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| A Alpha Aerospace | text PDFs | PASS | AS9100 Rev D and ISO 14001:2015 valid |
| B Beta Precision | ZIP | FAIL | ISO 14001 missing |
| C Gamma Hydraulics | scanned PDF + PNG image + PDFs | PASS | valid; certificates need OCR |
| D Delta Fluid | text PDFs | FAIL | ISO 14001 expired 2025-03-01 |
| E Echo Engineering | ZIP | PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW | ISO expiry `03/04/2028` is day/month ambiguous |

`expected_results.json` is the ground truth (written by the generator, independent of the system). B and D must never enter
technical or commercial evaluation. Ranking before review: A, C; after a reviewer confirms E: A, E, C.

```bash
cd backend
pytest tests/test_integration_dataset.py                              # fast: real OCR/ZIP/workflow, scripted LLM
HAL_RUN_LLM_TESTS=1 pytest -m llm tests/test_integration_live.py -s   # real Granite LLM + embedder (about 4 minutes)
```
